When an invitation is accepted, `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` emits `member.joined`. The same event is also emitted from `src/server/services/organization-service.ts`. I searched every `subscribe` call in `src`, and only two files register a handler for it:

- **`src/server/services/usage-service.ts`** (line 89, inside `registerUsageListeners`). It imports two repositories directly: `organization-repository` and `usage-repository`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** (line 231). This file attaches its handlers when the module loads, which happens because `event-registry.ts` imports it. It imports four repositories directly: `issue-repository`, `notification-repository`, `organization-repository` and `notification-preference-repository`.

The answer lists every repository these two files import directly, not only the ones the `member.joined` handlers themselves call. `organization-repository` is imported by both files, so it appears once.

ANSWER: src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts
